title: BeatEdit: Symbolic Music Generation as Explicit Editing
abstract: arXiv:2607.11124v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Music creation is fundamentally a process of revision. Yet symbolic music generation remains dominated by paradigms that produce complete sequences from scratch, with limited support for selective modification. Edit-based methods have proven effective for text transformation tasks, but remain largely unexplored for symbolic music. We trace this absence to the representational level: conventional event-based music encodings lack the structural properties required by explicit music editing. In contrast, the BEAT encoding, a beat-grid-anchored representation originally designed for autoregressive generation, possesses structural properties amenable to editing. We propose BeatEdit, the first framework for symbolic music generation based on explicit edit operations, recasting generation as producing new content by editing a draft rather than synthesizing from scratch. translated_title: BeatEdit：将符号音乐生成视为显式编辑
translated_abstract: 音乐创作本质上是一个不断修订的过程。然而，符号音乐生成领域仍然由从零开始生成完整序列的范式主导，对选择性修改的支持十分有限。基于编辑的方法已在文本转换任务中被证明有效，但在符号音乐领域却基本未被探索。我们将这一缺失归因于表示层面：传统的基于事件的音乐编码缺乏显式音乐编辑所需的结构特性。相比之下，BEAT编码——一种最初为自回归生成设计的节拍网格锚定表示——具备适合编辑操作的结构特性。我们提出BeatEdit，这是首个基于显式编辑操作的符号音乐生成框架，它将生成过程重新定义为通过编辑草稿来产生新内容，而非从零开始合成。BeatEdit包含沿着某一轴线的三种互补机制。
tldr: 本文提出BeatEdit，首个基于显式编辑操作的符号音乐生成框架，利用节拍网格锚定的BEAT编码，将音乐生成重新定义为对草稿的编辑而非从零合成。
en_tdlr: BeatEdit is the first framework for symbolic music generation based on explicit edit operations, recasting generation as editing a draft rather than synthesizing from scratch, enabled by the beat-grid-anchored BEAT encoding.
